judge_notes.opus5: The July setup repeated almost exactly - +13% into the print, six October target raises, 3.9% off the high - on a name that sold an unraised ARR guide 3 of the last 4 prints (i2), with a dated mechanism for the on-prem shortfall to persist (Micron's tightening memory supply against Q1's +1% term licences and -2% >$100k deals, i1); the revenue beat is inside the guide and is not the line (i0).
judge_notes.opus55: A repeat of the July setup (a 13% run-up on target raises into a print traded on net new ARR, where beats are sold), with the memory/hardware shortage that delayed Q1 on-prem deals tightening through the quarter; calls bid and 8% short temper it.
judge_notes.sonnet55: Re-run of the July setup (run-up and target raises into an ARR-driven print that sold -19.7%), with hardware-delay risk on net new ARR; call skew bid and 8.4% short temper it.
judge_notes.fable51: A re-run of the July setup (run-up, target raises, held ARR guide) on a name that sold beats three of the last four times, with the memory-driven hardware shortage that hit Q1 term licences tightening through the quarter; the call-bid skew and 8% short are why it is not larger.
